says: The talents micro menu icon: Blizzard's 53 px target, too small to upscale alone, upscaled once (Real-ESRGAN anime x4, to 1024) and redrawn by FLUX.1 [schnell] from a description of it, at three strengths. Option 3 (strength 0.55, seed 1) ships, keyed into sources/micromenu/upscaled-spectalents.png (piece micromenu).
